summary: AI review products can supply named review passes and structured feedback, while deterministic quality-gate platforms provide reproducible blocking criteria. A robust implementation combines both rather than treating an LLM verdict as a test result.

items.text: GitHub Copilot code review reviews selected changes or pull requests and can apply repository custom instructions that encode local review standards. Its comments and requested changes provide a named AI-review stage, while GitHub protections can keep the final merge decision separate.

Qodo Merge (formerly PR-Agent) exposes commands for review, code suggestions, compliance and test generation, and supports automatic invocation in repository workflows. Those distinct tools can be configured as specialized gate agents with machine-consumable findings.

CodeRabbit auto-review configuration controls target branches, labels, draft behavior and review status, while repository instructions tune the standards it checks. This implements policy-scoped automated review rather than an unbounded general critique.

SonarQube Quality Gates evaluate explicit conditions over static-analysis measures and return a pass/fail status that can block CI. They provide the deterministic evidence layer that should corroborate or override probabilistic agent claims.
